quote: The driver of any truck or combination of vehicles 80 inches or more in overall width, which is following a truck, or combination of vehicles 80 inches or more in overall width, shall, whenever conditions permit, leave a space of 500 feet so that an overtaking vehicle may enter and occupy such space without danger, but this shall not prevent a truck or combination of vehicles from overtaking and passing any vehicle or combination of vehicles. This subsection does not apply to any vehicle or combination of vehicles while moving on a highway on which there are two or more lanes available for traffic moving in the same direction.

activation.source_clause: The driver of any truck or combination of vehicles 80 inches or more in overall width, which is following a truck, or combination of vehicles 80 inches or more in overall width
activation.description: Two separate trucks or combinations each have overall width at least 80 inches; the subject follows the lead in the same direction.

obligation.source_clause: leave a space of 500 feet so that an overtaking vehicle may enter and occupy such space without danger
obligation.description: Observe the continuous original body-to-body space against the source 500-foot boundary and preserve the overtaking-entry safety question for review.

exceptions.source_clause: this shall not prevent a truck or combination of vehicles from overtaking and passing any vehicle or combination of vehicles
exceptions.description: Observe the actual passing interval and body/lane motion.

exceptions.source_clause: This subsection does not apply to any vehicle or combination of vehicles while moving on a highway on which there are two or more lanes available for traffic moving in the same direction.
exceptions.description: Count available same-direction lanes from the original highway source.

timing.description: Observe the full original following interval and passing state.

judgment_calls_needed.note: The source leaves whether physical traffic and road conditions permit the space to independent review.
